title: PhenotypeTemplates clinical context
description: Structured clinical knowledge about one phenotype, used by PhenotypeTemplates to generate cohort definitions. Cross-field rules (exit parameters, age range) are enforced by PhenotypeTemplates::validateClinicalContext().

source_phenotype.description: Name of the phenotype this context was written for (join key to concept sets).

source_definition.description: Free-text clinical description the context was derived from.

condition_name.description: Display name of the condition; may carry a disambiguating suffix.

clinical_rationale.description: Free-text justification for the structured choices below.

is_pharmacovigilance_outcome.description: Whether the condition is typically a pharmacovigilance outcome. Descriptive only.

clinical_course.description: Natural history of the condition. Sets the default cohort era and exit logic.

expected_care_setting.description: Where the condition is usually diagnosed. Controls the hospitalization variants generated.

sex_constraint.description: Restricts the cohort to one sex. Defaults to BOTH_SEXES.

min_age_years.description: Minimum age in years at index, if the condition is age restricted.

max_age_years.description: Maximum age in years at index, if the condition is age restricted.

minimum_interepisode_gap_days.description: Gap in days separating distinct episodes. Required when the exit resolves to an era with persistence gap.

recommended_cohort_exit.description: Overrides the cohort exit implied by clinical_course.

recommended_exit_days.description: Days from index to cohort exit. Required when the exit resolves to a fixed window.

has_discrete_recorded_symptoms.description: Symptoms are discretely recorded in the 30 days before diagnosis.

requires_diagnostic_test_or_procedure.description: A diagnostic test or procedure is expected in the 30 days before diagnosis.

requires_active_treatment_within_30d.description: Condition-specific treatment is expected within 30 days after diagnosis.

expects_condition_specific_followup_or_s.description: Condition-specific follow-up care or sequelae are expected within 1 year.

confidence.description: Confidence of the author in this context. Descriptive only.
